description: C3 (location-escalation lever, 1200 s -- run ONLY if C2 underwhelms). Same 1200 s duration as C2, MOVED to the short-link spillback approach: road_2_4_3_1, the single through lane of intersection_2_3's North approach. Highest demand/storage ratio of any central approach (186 vehicles over a 572.8 m link, storage ~76 veh -> ratio 2.44 vs C2's 2.00 on a 772.8 m link), so the queue outgrows link storage soonest and spills upstream into intersection_2_4. The C2->C3 delta is the pure location lever (duration held at 1200 s). Lane 1 is the only N->S straight lane, full movement kill. Position 10 m = segment 1. Dual message: intersection_2_3 approach-full (North / through / segment 1, NTST phase); intersection_2_4 downstream (South exit, 1 of 3 lanes, 562.8 m past on the 572.8 m link). start 500, end 1700. If even this is mild, the last resort is two adjacent lanes at one approach (a severe multi-lane incident -- a stronger claim to defend); author that only if needed.
